# telnyx_notification_channel (Resource)

A notification channel, which delivers the notifications of a notification profile by email, SMS, voice call or webhook to one destination.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_notification_profile" "ops" {
  name = "Operations"
}

resource "telnyx_notification_channel" "ops_email" {
  notification_profile_id = telnyx_notification_profile.ops.id
  channel_type_id         = "email"
  channel_destination     = "ops@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `channel_destination` (String) Where notifications are delivered: an email address, a +E.164 phone number or a webhook URL, depending on `channel_type_id`.
- `channel_type_id` (String) How notifications are delivered: `email`, `sms`, `voice` or `webhook`. One of `email`, `sms`, `voice`, `webhook`.
- `notification_profile_id` (String) A UUID reference to the associated Notification Profile.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Identifies the notification channel.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_notification_channel.ops_email <id>
```
